entity.title: Select the camera entity

data.media_players: Media players for the audio stream

data_description.model_download: Off: you place the ONNX files in config/babycam/models yourself (nothing is ever downloaded). Download once: fetch missing models a single time. Download and keep updated: also check daily for newer models.
data_description.model_manifest_url: Where the models.json manifest is fetched from. Default is the 'models' release of the BabyCam GitHub repository.

error.invalid_roi: The region must be four numbers between 0 and 1: x1,y1,x2,y2
error.invalid_url: The manifest URL must start with http:// or https://
